states.meaning: Named in the email ontology; no contract yet.
Message contract complete: purpose, trigger, consent class, personalization, copy fields, components.
Creative territory chosen inside the family grammar; ready for an authority design.
A full email authority (mobile + desktop) is with the founder.
The founder approved the full authority.
Assets decomposed from the approved authority and fabricated; founder approved them.
Template spec, assets and fixtures complete for implementation.
Email-safe HTML template exists and renders with fixtures.
Client matrix, image-blocked and dark-mode checks pass.
Provider delivery, links, suppression and idempotency verified with test recipients.
Founder approved the implemented email for release.
Replaced by a newer approved template; kept as a record.

approval_rule: Founder approval is never inferred. A state that requires the founder can only be set from an explicit founder decision recorded with a date.

pipeline.name: CREATIVE TERRITORY
pipeline.output: artifact, primary gesture, secondary detail, contrast anchor

pipeline.name: FULL EMAIL AUTHORITY
pipeline.output: one complete email image per viewport, with sample copy, for review only

pipeline.name: RESPONSIVE AUTHORITY
pipeline.output: mobile and desktop authorities + image-blocked plan

pipeline.name: ASSET DECOMPOSITION
pipeline.output: asset list: class, lineage action, live-content zones removed

pipeline.name: SIDEKICK / ARTIFACT GENERATION
pipeline.output: clean shells, inserts, environments — no live content

pipeline_rule: FULL EMAIL AUTHORITY BEFORE ASSET DECOMPOSITION. Do not generate random plates in advance.

never: repetitive production code across many templates
changing families, doctrine or approved authorities

events.note: Hard bounces suppress the address for non-critical classes.
Only where the provider reports it and it is meaningful; Apple Mail Privacy Protection inflates opens, so never optimize on it.
The app route opened from the email link.
From the preference centre once it exists.
Only a product-truth event (e.g. setup completed after A03), never a proxy.

guardrails: No open-rate or click-rate targets for E06 (security) — success is the user completing the action.
No re-send loops on non-open; cooldowns are fixed by contract, not tuned for engagement.
No streaks, scores or urgency mechanics.
Analytics never changes what a TRANSACTIONAL email says.
Link tracking must not break security links: verification and reset links are never wrapped by click tracking.
